title: Making purple gold
summary: NileRed tries to make a ring from pure purple gold, a gold-aluminium intermetallic that is brittle and hard to work with. The 53-minute video follows the chemistry and many failed attempts before he produces a finished ring.
why: HN mentions it as a fascinating example of chemistry persistence and as something people learned from, such as discovering purple gold exists.

quote.text: There's a fascinating video of a fellow trying to make a ring out of Purple Gold.
